name: orieg/judy-cache
description: PSR-16 cache backed by Judy arrays, with O(range) prefix invalidation. For long-running PHP (Octane, Swoole, RoadRunner, FrankenPHP workers).

suggest.ext-judy: The native extension: C-speed operations and lower memory. Use >= 2.6.0 — earlier versions have a use-after-free in the teardown of the STRING_TO_MIXED types this package is built on (php-judy#162) (pie install orieg/judy)
suggest.symfony/cache: To use JudyAdapter as a Symfony Cache / PSR-6 pool
